# Bharat Relocators

> Bharat Relocators is a relocation and logistics service provider based in Kolkata, West Bengal, offering household shifting, vehicle transportation, corporate office relocation, international moving, and express parcel shipping across Kolkata and PAN-India highway corridors.

Headquartered in Haltu, Kolkata, with an operational branch in Behala, Bharat Relocators coordinates residential moves, motorcycle crating, enclosed car carrier transit, commercial office transfers, and part-load parcel freight connecting Kolkata with major destinations across India.

## Core Services

- [Household Shifting](https://bharatrelocators.com/household-shifting): Residential home relocation featuring 5-layer protective packing, modular furniture dismantling, dedicated closed container trucks, and room-by-room setup.
- [Car Transportation](https://bharatrelocators.com/car-shifting): Dedicated enclosed car carrier transport across India with low-angle hydraulic loading ramps, wheel-locking chocks, and transit insurance.
- [Bike Transport](https://bharatrelocators.com/bike-shifting): Specialized two-wheeler and motorcycle transportation with multi-layer bubble wrap, optional custom wooden crating, and enclosed transit.
- [Parcel & Cargo Shifting](https://bharatrelocators.com/parcel-shifting): Express part-load courier and luggage shipping connecting Kolkata with 230+ cities across India with doorstep pickup and consignment tracking.
- [Office Relocation](https://bharatrelocators.com/office-relocation): Structured commercial office moves with anti-static IT server handling, modular desk dismantling, and weekend execution to eliminate business downtime.
- [International Moving](https://bharatrelocators.com/international-moving): Overseas household relocation from Kolkata with export-grade seaworthy packing, customs paperwork guidance, and air/sea freight coordination.
